in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'तुग़रा' अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आधिकारिक हस्ताक्षर या मोहर। इस नाम का उपयोग शासकों और राजाओं द्वारा अपने आधिकारिक दस्तावेजों पर किया जाता था। यह नाम शक्ति और आधिकारिकता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: توغره
in_pashto.meaning: د رسمي لاسلیک یا مهر څرګندونکی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'توغره' نوم د عربي کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د رسمي لاسلیک یا مهر دی. دا نوم د واکمنانو او پاچاهانو لخوا د رسمي اسنادو لپاره کارول کیده. 'توغره' د قدرت او رسمیت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Tughra
in_english.meaning: A name signifying an official seal or signature
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tughra originates from Arabic roots, specifically referring to the official seal or signature used by rulers and monarchs. Historically, it holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, particularly within the Ottoman Empire where the tuğra was an essential part of a sultan's formal documents. The name symbolizes authority, power, and authenticity.

data.cultural_impact: Tughra held immense cultural significance as a symbol of power and authority in the Islamic world. It was used as a personal seal and emblem by Ottoman sultans, Mughal emperors, and other rulers in the Islamic world. These decorative calligraphic monograms, representing the ruler's name or title, were widely used on official documents, coins, and other forms of visual communication to establish authenticity and sovereignty.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Tughra can be seen as a reminder of God's ultimate power and sovereignty. Islamic calligraphy, including the intricate designs of Tughra, has long been revered for its connection to the divine and its ability to evoke a sense of awe and reverence for the Creator. The use of Tughra as a symbol of worldly power is a testament to the belief that true power ultimately comes from God, and that leaders are merely His stewards on Earth. Through the study and practice of calligraphy, Muslims have sought to connect with the divine and deepen their spiritual connection with their Creator.
